recognize_zh: 中央有一顆胞質淡藍、帶細空泡的大巨噬細胞（nurse cell），周圍一圈大小不一、胞質由嗜鹼到多染的有核紅血球環繞，這種玫瑰花狀排列就是紅血球島（erythroblastic island）。
features: Central large macrophage with a round nucleus, open chromatin and pale grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Rosette of about a dozen erythroid precursors clustered tightly around the macrophage
Erythroblasts at mixed stages: larger basophilic (early) forms with finer chromatin and smaller polychromatophilic/orthochromatic forms with dense round nuclei
Round, regular nuclear contours without megaloblastic or dysplastic change visible
Background of blood-rich marrow aspirate with scattered isolated erythroblasts and a band/segmented granulocyte
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows an erythroblastic island composed of a central macrophage with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm surrounded by a rosette of erythroid precursors. The erythroblasts span multiple stages of maturation, from basophilic erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm to late polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts with condensed round nuclei. No megaloblastic change, nuclear budding or multinucleation is evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a normal erythroblastic island (nurse-cell niche) of erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis shows erythroid cells or other hematopoietic cells engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm, whereas here the erythroblasts lie on the macrophage surface in an organized rosette.

ddx.dx: Tumor cell clump (e.g., metastatic small round cell tumor)
ddx.vs: Metastatic clusters are cohesive sheets of uniform atypical cells without a central macrophage or a spectrum of hemoglobinizing erythroid maturation.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts are larger with sieve-like open chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, which is not seen in these compact, normally condensed nuclei.
